claim: Creating or restoring an Aurora MySQL version 2 or 3, or Aurora PostgreSQL version 11 database automatically enrolls that database in Amazon RDS Extended Support, and you can opt out to avoid charges; the document history lists this on March 21, 2024.
question: What happens when you create or restore an Aurora MySQL version 2 database after its end of standard support?

values.display: automatically enrolls that database into Amazon RDS Extended Support
values.spoken: automatically enrolls the database in Extended Support

qualifiers.scope: Aurora MySQL version 2 or 3 and Aurora PostgreSQL version 11 databases
